title: Rookies

content_zh:
“啊？”
“丑话先说在前头——不管你是走谁的门路进了十六院，都别来和我抢师医生——”短发女孩掠了胡悦一眼，伸出手拂过浏海，手腕上的劳力士金表闪闪发光。“这个助理的位置，我要了，明白吗？”
太阳自十六院上空升起，但这比不过这座医院本身的光芒。
S市十六院，这个字，扔在地上都能荡起金光，太阳刚从地平线升起，医院门口已汇聚起人流，排号的，买号的，卖号的，这里的大部分纠纷都和号有关，探病的看病的多少都带点优越感，能走进医院大楼，手里握着一个预约号，已是赢家。
“连创佳绩，再接再厉，继去年我院心血管科主任医师张玉于《柳叶刀》杂志发表论文之后，今年三季度以来，我院科研人员与医师共计发表核心刊物论文30余篇，国际知名刊物论文4篇”
“热烈祝贺我院DNA检验科再创佳绩，与公安机关合作破获多年悬案，受害人家属送上锦旗，感谢我医院率先引入国际先进DNA检测技术”
“为解决‘排队难’问题，我院将引入电子排号预约系统，病人家属可于近日在网上平台预约挂号，将有效打击‘票贩子’、‘黄牛’，杜绝倒卖预约号乱象”……
十六院是很有钱的，这点从院刊上就能看得出来——首先，能拥有院刊，已经是成功的象征。现在大多医院更情愿把有限的经费用在官网建设上，只有十六院这样的大型医院，才会定期印刷精美的铜版纸刊物摆放在杂志角，即使根本就没有多少人会看。其次，十六院不但有资金印刷院刊，而且还有经费制作院内新闻，在等候区滚动播放，向患者宣传本院的丰功伟业。每年发了多少论文，出了多少个学科带头人……
但很少有人耐心去看，这些丰功伟绩不过是耳边的杂音，大多人都沉浸在自己的世界里：大部分来看病的人心情总不会太好，十六院的门诊大楼很少有气氛轻松的楼层，大多数患者的眉头都是紧锁着的。
但有一层不一样，这一层的气氛很特别，更欢快——而且就医者大多负担不起皱眉这么奢侈的动作。
那会长皱纹的。
人当然也还是多，7点刚过，就诊者就陆续就位——不好说她们是患者，大部分人说不上有什么毛病。绝大多数人脸上都带着笑意，抬手去掠头发的时候，无意间会露出手腕间的璀璨钻光。
“爱马仕Lindy。”
“哦，又一个爱马仕——Brikin。”
“假的吧。”
“说不清，鳄鱼皮的，如果是真的，很贵哦。”
“香奈儿流浪。”
“Coach，哇，有点坍台啊。”
“Furla——小女孩背背这两个牌子也蛮好的，少女感强嘛。”
“除非她小于三岁。”短发女孩撇撇嘴。

“小于三岁的话，大部分家庭都选用Burberry和爱马仕那种牌子的婴幼儿线的。”中等身材的男人笑了笑，伸出手，“我申永峰，乳.房方向的。”
以他们的穿着，评论就诊者似有些过分——全都是一身白袍，白袍下面也是质量粗劣的流水线制服，有什么资格居高临下地去评论别人？但这里坐的每个人优越感都很足，自信心也强得过分，很快有人握住申永峰的手。
“卢阳雨，皮肤方向，博士。”他说了个如雷贯耳的校名。
“哈哈，兄弟院校啊，我是你们隔壁的本博连读。”
“八年制的吧？兄弟以后多照应。”
一听就知道这是新入职的住院医师在互报家门，招聘考试的时候都打过照面，只是没什么说话的机会，大家都是夹生熟，江湖相见，盘下道来是基本功，卢阳雨性格有点张扬，开始也许还想炫耀一下羽毛，但申永峰一开口，人家不但是隔壁更牛院校的，而且还是本博连读。
国内的医学教育体系繁多，各种学制之间免不得互相攀比，五年制、八年制、本博连读、本硕连读，而且也很认本科院校出身，申永峰的出身在国内可以说是蓝血贵族，顶尖大校、热门专业、本博连读，应该是前0.01%的人才。卢阳雨没那么秀了，那个短发女孩子眼珠子转过来看看他，仰起头说，“我们这里应该都是博士——戴韶华，我颌面修复的，硕士博士都在俄国读。”

content_en:
"Huh?"
"Let's talk ugly first - no matter whose route you take to enter the Sixth Hospital, don't come and compete with me as a doctor -" The short-haired girl glanced at Hu Yue, stretched out her hand to brush her bangs, and the gold Rolex watch on her wrist was shining. "I want this assistant's position, do you understand?"
The sun rises over the Sixteenth Hospital, but it cannot compare with the brilliance of the hospital itself.
S City Sixteenth Hospital, the word "Sixteenth Hospital", can sparkle with golden light when thrown on the ground. The sun has just risen from the horizon, and crowds of people have gathered at the entrance of the hospital. People are queuing, buying, and selling numbers. Most of the disputes here are related to numbers. Visitors and doctors have a sense of superiority. Being able to walk into the hospital building with a reservation number in their hands is already a winner.
"We have achieved continuous success and will continue to work hard. After Zhang Yu, chief physician of the cardiovascular department of our hospital, published a paper in The Lancet last year, since the third quarter of this year, our hospital's scientific researchers and doctors have published more than 30 papers in core publications and 4 papers in internationally renowned publications."
"Warm congratulations to the DNA testing department of our hospital for achieving another great success and cooperating with the public security organs to solve a case that has been pending for many years. The victim's family sent a banner and thanked our hospital for taking the lead in introducing international advanced DNA testing technology."
"In order to solve the problem of 'difficulty in queuing', our hospital will introduce an electronic reservation system. Patients' families can make appointments on the online platform in the near future. This will effectively crack down on 'ticket dealers' and 'scalpers' and put an end to the chaos of reselling reservation numbers"...
The Sixteenth Academy is very wealthy, which can be seen from the journals - first of all, having journals is already a symbol of success. Nowadays, most hospitals are more willing to spend their limited funds on the construction of official websites. Only large hospitals like the 16th Hospital will regularly print exquisite coated paper publications and place them in the magazine corner, even if not many people will read them. Secondly, the Sixteenth Hospital not only has the funds to print the hospital journal, but also has the funds to produce hospital news, which is broadcast in the waiting area to promote the great achievements of the hospital to patients. How many papers are published every year, how many subject leaders are produced...
But few people have the patience to look at it. These great achievements are just noise in their ears. Most people are immersed in their own world: most people who come to see the doctor are not in a good mood. The outpatient building of the 16th Hospital rarely has a relaxing floor, and most patients have frowns.
But there is one floor that is different. The atmosphere on this floor is very special and more cheerful - and most of the medical patients cannot afford such a luxurious action as frowning.
That will cause wrinkles.
Of course, there were still a lot of people. Just after 7 o'clock, patients began to arrive one after another - it was hard to say that they were patients, and most of them couldn't say there was anything wrong with them. Most of the people had smiles on their faces, and when they raised their hands to brush their hair, they would inadvertently reveal the dazzling light between their wrists.
"Hermès Lindy."
"Oh, another Hermès - Brikin."
"It's fake."
"I can't tell. If it's crocodile skin, it's very expensive."
"Chanel wanders."
"Coach, wow, it's a bit of a collapse."
"Furla - it's good for a little girl to memorize these two brands. It feels girly."
"Unless she is less than three years old." The short-haired girl pouted.
"If you are less than three years old, most families will use brands such as Burberry and Hermès for infants and toddlers." The medium-sized man smiled and stretched out his hand, "I am Shen Yongfeng, the one facing the breast."
Judging from their clothing, it seems a bit excessive to comment on the patients - they are all wearing white robes, and underneath the white robes are also poor-quality assembly line uniforms. What qualifications do you have to comment on others in a condescending manner? But everyone sitting here had a strong sense of superiority and excessive self-confidence. Soon someone held Shen Yongfeng's hand.
"Lu Yangyu, skin direction, doctor." He said the name of the school that resonated with everyone.
"Haha, brother schoolsAh, I am Benbo Liandu next door to you. "
“Eight-year system, right? Brother, please take care of me in the future. "
As soon as I heard it, I knew that this was a newly recruited resident doctor who was applying to each other. They had met each other during the recruitment examination, but there was no chance to talk. Everyone was familiar with each other, and meeting each other in the world was a basic skill. Lu Yangyu had a bit of a flamboyant personality, and he might have wanted to show off his feathers at first, but when Shen Yongfeng opened his mouth, he not only came from a more powerful college next door, but also had a bachelor's degree.
There are many medical education systems in the country, and comparisons between various school systems are unavoidable. Five-year, eight-year, bachelor's and doctoral programs, bachelor's and master's programs, and he also values his undergraduate school background. Shen Yongfeng's background can be said to be a blue-blood aristocrat in China. He should be among the top 0.01% of talents in top universities, popular majors, and bachelor's and master's programs. Lu Yangyu was no longer so showy. The short-haired girl turned her eyes to look at him, raised her head and said, "We should all have PhDs here - Dai Shaohua, who is a maxillofacial restoration specialist, studied for his master's and PhD degrees in Russia. "
